visual_review: Before read as a clamp or faucet over a box: a flat bar hand with a stray hook and a straight-sided box instead of the cup bin. Redrawn on VRECT_L: a cuff box taller than the wrist, the back of the hand rising to a knuckle, a long index finger pointing down-left on a 1:3 band with an r5 tip, a V notch and an r4 thumb, over a tapered cup bin with an overhanging rim, rounded bottom corners, 9 under the fingertip. Reads as a hand lowering toward a bin at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Index and thumb only (reference's separate finger outlines merged into one hand silhouette at the 8-unit spacing).
